name: CONUS
long_description:
CONUS structures fragmented medical device information for surgeons. We combine manufacturer documentation, hospital protocols and medical research in one place, giving surgeons and MedTech teams reliable answers across products and procedures through search and source-backed AI.

We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet, and since launching six months ago we’ve gone live in 27 hospitals, with 49 more onboarding.

Long term, hospitals will use CONUS to source and order surgical devices across manufacturers.
